one_liner: Mailchimp Marketing API v3 is a broad REST API with self-serve API keys and OAuth 2; no official MCP for the API is confirmed by the pages (only an unverified community server).
auth_notes: API keys and OAuth 2 tokens are both accepted, sent as HTTP Basic (token as password) or Bearer. OAuth 2 is recommended for accessing other users' accounts. The data center prefix (dc) must be resolved per account (it is in the API key suffix or via the OAuth metadata endpoint). Token lifetime and app registration steps are not shown in the fetched pages.
access_notes: Pages say to create a Mailchimp account and then get an API key; no paid plan is stated as required for key creation, but what the API can do depends on plan level. The fetched pages do not explicitly confirm a free tier, so this is inferred. Partner program (25+ active users) is optional and free to apply.
blocker_notes: Plan level affects what the API can do, but the pages show no gate on getting an API key. MCP status is not settled by the pages; the community server is carried over from the draft without page support.

evidence.quote: You can either use HTTP Basic Authentication or Bearer Authentication.
For building integrations that let other users access data from their own Mailchimp accounts, you should [authenticate with OAuth 2](/developer/marketing/guides/access-user-data-oauth-2/).
If you don’t have a Mailchimp account already, you’ll need to [create one](https://login.mailchimp.com/signup/) in order to use the API.
Once you have an account and are logged in, you can [get an API key](https://us1.admin.mailchimp.com/account/api/)
The root url for the API is `https://<dc>.api.mailchimp.com/3.0/`.
